generations.prompt: The camera is locked on this same blank dark phone on a desk. Nothing in the picture moves. Close offscreen sound is the entire action: an adult woman in her late thirties, with a natural medium-low voice and a tired contemporary American speaking manner, exhales one clearly audible, long, softly breathy sigh of resignation. She first takes a small breath through her nose, then slowly lets it out through her slightly open mouth, one audible "hhh" exhale lasting about one and a half seconds. This is a real quiet human sigh captured close to a microphone, not speech or a whispered word, not a gasp, not a groan, not crying. Begin the breath after half a second, then leave a quiet tail. Her face and body remain entirely offscreen. Minimal still indoor room tone. No words, no music, no other sounds, no screen text.
